lines.en: Welcome to the castle. This hall was built in 1280, you know.
lines.pt: Bem-vinda ao castelo. Este salão foi construído em 1280, sabia?

lines.en: Wow, that is old. Was the whole castle built at that time?
lines.pt: Uau, isso é antigo. O castelo inteiro foi construído nessa época?

lines.en: No. The tower was added later, and the walls were rebuilt after a fire.
lines.pt: Não. A torre foi acrescentada depois, e os muros foram reconstruídos após um incêndio.

lines.en: Who was the castle used by? Kings or soldiers?
lines.pt: Por quem o castelo era usado? Reis ou soldados?

lines.en: Kings lived here, but the gates were guarded by soldiers day and night.
lines.pt: Reis moravam aqui, mas os portões eram vigiados por soldados dia e noite.

lines.en: And when was this painting made? It looks very old too.
lines.pt: E quando foi feita esta pintura? Parece muito antiga também.

lines.en: It was painted in 1650. The frame was carved by a local artist.
lines.pt: Foi pintada em 1650. A moldura foi entalhada por um artista local.

lines.en: Amazing. Was the castle ever attacked by an army?
lines.pt: Incrível. O castelo já foi atacado por algum exército?

lines.en: Yes, it was attacked twice. The old bridge was destroyed in a war.
lines.pt: Sim, foi atacado duas vezes. A ponte antiga foi destruída numa guerra.

lines.en: I see. When was the museum opened to visitors?
lines.pt: Entendi. Quando o museu foi aberto aos visitantes?

lines.en: It was opened in 1900, and visitors have loved it ever since.
lines.pt: Foi aberto em 1900, e os visitantes adoram desde então.

facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Use was ou were + particípio: was built, were rebuilt. Use by + pessoa só se for importante.

facts.label: foi/foram + particípio
facts.sub: Use was ou were + particípio para falar do passado sem focar em quem fez: The hall was built in 1280. The walls were rebuilt. Was para singular e were para plural.

facts.label: por + agente
facts.sub: Use by quando quiser dizer quem fez: The frame was carved by a local artist. Se o agente não importa, não use by: The tower was added later.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “foi construído em 1280” e “foram vigiados por soldados”.
compare.us: Em inglês, use was ou were + particípio: was built, were guarded. Use by + pessoa só quando for importante. Was para singular e were para plural.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: The hall was built in 1280.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The hall was built in 1280 means someone built it then.
items.why: Yes, the hall is the focus.

items.s: We form the past passive with was or were + past participle.

items.why: Walls is plural, so we say were rebuilt.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The hall was built in 1280 means someone built it then. → Verdadeiro (Yes, the hall is the focus.)
We form the past passive with was or were + past participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The walls was rebuilt.” → Falso (Walls is plural, so we say were rebuilt.)
